X13-14.effect:

[When Braved] (When This Spirit Brave Attacks)
By destroying a Spirit you control, draw a card. However, you can't activate that Spirit's (When Destroyed) effects.

X13-13.name: Dark-Tyrannosaura-Overrex
X13-13.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Target and attack an opposing Spirit.
[Rush: Green]
(While you have a Green symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Green Core]: When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, send a core from the opposing Life to the Reserve.

X13-15.name: Magical Hammer
X13-15.effect:
[Brave Condition: Cost 4 or more]

[When Braved] (When This Spirit Brave Attacks)
The opponent can send a core from their Reserve to their Life. When cores are sent to the opposing Life via this effect, you can send a core from your Reserve to your Life.

X13-17.name: The SixShieldEmperor Kei
X13-17.effect:
This Spirit card can't be summoned without paying at least one cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
All your Spirits are unaffected by opposing Burst effects.

[LV3] (Your End Step)
By returning one of your Spirits to the deckbottom, activate your Burst of the same color and an equal or lower cost than that returned Spirit, ignoring the Burst condition.

X13-16.name: The SupremeHero Manaka
X13-16.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is destroyed by the opponent]
When the total color of Spirits you control is two or more, summon this Spirit card.

[LV1][LV2][LV3][LV4] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing "Supreme Hero" family Spirit.

[LV2][LV3][LV4]
While the opponent has a Burst set/controls any Spirit with a Burst effect, this Spirit gains +10000 BP.
